TAILSPACE TAGS + FILTERS UPDATE — VERSION 1.6.6

This ZIP is meant to replace the files on the MAIN branch of:
https://github.com/reddj2/tailspace-tachimanga-extension

WHAT THIS BUILD ADDS
- Tag filtering inside Tachimanga.
- Tap once to include a tag.
- Tap twice to exclude a tag.
- Multiple included tags are sent as repeated tag= parameters.
- Multiple excluded tags are sent as repeated excludeTag= parameters.
- The build action refreshes the current Tailspace tag IDs automatically.

IMPORTANT
Upload the CONTENTS of this ZIP to the root of the main branch. Do not upload
one outer folder containing everything.

The repo branch is generated automatically. Do not manually edit the repo
branch.
